BANKTECH ANALYTICS — FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ)

=======================================================
1. CURRENT ACCOUNT FEES AND MINIMUM BALANCE
=======================================================

Q: What are the fees associated with a current account?
A: Current accounts may be subject to monthly maintenance fees, transaction charges, and fees for
value-added services such as cheque books, demand drafts, and RTGS/NEFT transfers. Fee schedules
vary by account type (Basic, Premium, Business). Please refer to our official website or visit
your nearest branch for the latest schedule of charges.

Q: Is there a minimum balance requirement for current accounts?
A: Yes, current accounts typically carry a minimum average monthly balance (AMB) requirement.
Failure to maintain the required AMB may attract a non-maintenance charge. The exact AMB
requirement differs across account variants. Contact your branch or log in to mobile banking
to view the requirement applicable to your account.

=======================================================
2. MOBILE BANKING APP FEATURES
=======================================================

Q: What can I do with the BankTech mobile banking app?
A: Our mobile banking application allows you to:
   - View account balances and transaction history
   - Transfer funds (IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI)
   - Pay utility bills, insurance premiums, and credit card dues
   - Open fixed and recurring deposits
   - Apply for loans and credit cards
   - Raise and track service requests
   - Locate ATMs and branches on an interactive map
   - Set spending alerts and account notifications

Q: Is the mobile banking app available on both Android and iOS?
A: Yes, the app is available on both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store. Ensure
you download the official app to protect your account security.

=======================================================
3. FIXED DEPOSIT INTEREST RATES
=======================================================

Q: What interest rates are offered on Fixed Deposits (FDs)?
A: Fixed deposit interest rates vary based on the tenure of the deposit, the deposit amount, and
prevailing market conditions set by our Asset-Liability Committee. Preferential rates may be
available for senior citizens. For the most current and accurate rates, please visit our
official website or speak to a relationship manager at your nearest branch.

Q: Can interest be paid out monthly or quarterly rather than at maturity?
A: Yes, payout options (monthly, quarterly, or at maturity) are available for most fixed deposit
products. The effective yield may differ depending on the payout option selected.

=======================================================
4. KYC (KNOW YOUR CUSTOMER) REQUIREMENTS
=======================================================

Q: What documents are needed to complete KYC?
A: As per regulatory guidelines, all customers must complete KYC verification. Generally accepted
documents include government-issued photo identity proof (passport, Aadhaar card, voter ID,
driving licence) and address proof. For businesses, additional documents such as incorporation
certificates, GST registration, and authorised signatory declarations are required.

Q: Can I complete KYC online (Video KYC)?
A: Yes, subject to eligibility and regulatory approvals, Video KYC (V-KYC) is available through
our mobile app and internet banking portal. You will need a stable internet connection, a live
camera, and your original identity documents during the video call.

=======================================================
5. DISPUTE RESOLUTION PROCESS
=======================================================

Q: How do I raise a dispute on an unauthorised transaction?
A: If you notice an unauthorised or erroneous transaction, report it immediately by:
   1. Calling our 24×7 customer care helpline
   2. Submitting a dispute via internet banking or the mobile app
   3. Visiting your nearest branch with supporting documentation
Disputes are typically acknowledged within two working days and resolved within the timeframe
prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India's customer protection guidelines.

Q: What happens after I raise a dispute?
A: Once a dispute is registered, our investigations team reviews all relevant transaction logs.
If the dispute is upheld, the amount is credited to your account as per regulatory timelines.
You will receive updates via SMS and email at each stage of the process.

=======================================================
6. CONTACT CHANNELS
=======================================================

Q: How can I contact customer support?
A: You may reach us through any of the following channels:
   - Visit our official website for live chat and service request forms
   - Visit your nearest branch during working hours
   - Use the in-app Help & Support section for guided assistance
For the current helpline numbers, email addresses, and branch locator, please visit the official
website or your nearest branch.

=======================================================
7. DIGITAL BANKING SECURITY BEST PRACTICES
=======================================================

Q: How can I keep my account safe while using digital banking?
A: We strongly recommend the following security practices:
   - Never share your login credentials, OTPs, or PINs with anyone, including bank staff
   - Always log out of mobile and internet banking sessions after use
   - Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on all digital banking channels
   - Regularly update your mobile banking app to receive the latest security patches
   - Avoid accessing your bank account on public or shared Wi-Fi networks
   - Set up transaction alerts so you are notified of every debit and credit
   - Verify the authenticity of emails and SMS messages before clicking on links
   - Report suspicious activity to our customer care team immediately

BankTech Analytics is committed to protecting your financial data. If you suspect your account
has been compromised, contact us immediately through official channels listed on our website.
